## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-fascicle topical outline (科 *kē*) for the commentary on Dàoxuān's *Hánzhù jièběn* ([KR6k0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0131)), recorded (錄 *lù*) by **Yuánzhào** 元照 ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7)). The 科 *kē* genre — outlines / topical synopses — is a standard medieval Chinese Buddhist scholastic apparatus providing the analytical structure of a parent commentary.

**Abstract**

Yuánzhào's outline supplies the working analytical structure for the study of the Dàoxuān-period *Hánzhù jièběn* commentary tradition. The outline format facilitated rapid reference and instructional use, making the parent text accessible to Sòng-period students of the *Sìfēn* Vinaya.
